Governo.titolo: Il Presidente Meloni all'Assemblea Generale di Assolombarda
Governo.descrizione: Il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, ha partecipato all’Assemblea Generale di Assolombarda presso il Teatro Dal Verme, a Milano.

Governo.titolo: Il Presidente Meloni esprime la sua vicinanza al Santo Padre
Governo.descrizione: Desidero rivolgere al Santo Padre la mia vicinanza personale e quella del Governo italiano per la prova che è chiamato ad affrontare nei prossimi giorni. La serenità e la tranquillità con cui ne ha parlato nell'Angelus di oggi ci rincuorano. Sono certa che anche il popolo italiano non farà mancare il proprio sostegno e il proprio affetto.

Governo.titolo: Dichiarazione del Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni
Governo.descrizione: Condanno con fermezza gli attacchi degli Houthi che hanno colpito l’aeroporto di Riad. Sono vicina all’Arabia Saudita e alle famiglie delle vittime e auguro ai feriti pronta guarigione. Gli attacchi contro i civili e le infrastrutture civili sono inaccettabili e devono cessare. L’Italia continuerà a lavorare con i partner della Regione per ridurre le tensioni e promuovere la stabilità e la libertà

Governo.descrizione: Il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, ha partecipato oggi al Vertice del gruppo “MED9”, a Spalato, in Croazia. Al termine dei lavori, i Leader hanno tenuto una conferenza stampa congiunta.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: President von der Leyen attends UN General Assembly underscoring the EU's commitment to multilateralism
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: President Ursula von der Leyen was in New York last week to participate in the 81st UN General Assembly. Throughout the week, the President engaged with world leaders and took part in several high-level events, underscoring the EU's commitment to multilateralism and to the role of the UN.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Strengthening Uptake and Exploitation of Horizon Europe “Civil Security” Research and Innovation: Tips for Proposers
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: This document provides practical guidance to help Horizon Europe Cluster-3 applicants strengthen the exploitation and uptake of project results from the earliest stages of project design through implementation and beyond the end of the project.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The Commission launches a repository for transparency information on online political ads
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Commission launches pilot European Repository for online political ads, boosting transparency and accountability. The platform helps publishers meet rules and enables researchers, journalists and citizens to scrutinise sponsors, funding and targeting.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Read-out by President von der Leyen following her call with President Zelenskyy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Good call with President Zelenskyy. Fully supported the call of President Zelenskyy for a ceasefire that would protect global food supplies and energy infrastructure in Ukraine and Russia.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: World Mental Health Day: let’s talk and listen
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: World Mental Health Day on October 10 serves as a reminder that good mental health is important and how we can prioritise it in our lives. This year’s theme ‘Lived experiences heard: real voices, real change’ stresses how conversations about mental health make a difference.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Europe’s skills ambitions need a regional lens
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Skills challenges are not evenly distributed in the EU. National averages often conceal major differences within countries, leading policies to sometimes overlook regional realities. To support focused actions, investment and cooperation, Cedefop has launched the Regional Skills Ecosystems Index.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Bulgaria, Greece and Romania step up delivery of strategic transport links
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Bulgaria, Greece and Romania signed a joint Action Plan to accelerate strategic cross-border transport projects in South-East Europe.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission approves €40.5 million French State aid to support agricultural, fishery and transport companies facing increased fuel prices
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved two French State aid schemes to support companies affected by increased fuel prices due to the Middle East crisis. €23.3 million will be allocated to support transport companies, and €17.2 million to support agricultural, fishery and aquaculture companies,

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Over 2,800 illegal firearms and 40,000 pieces of ammunition seized in operation in Europe and Asia
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Two-week operation reveals threat posed by high levels of trafficking of illicit conflict-origin weapons.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Spanish early childhood educator finds her ideal role in Germany
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Nerea Barroso Clarós achieved her ambition of working abroad when she moved from Barcelona to Germany’s North Rhine-Westphalia region with support from the EURES Targeted Mobility Scheme (TMS).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The Council updates the EU list of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions as cooperation delivers further progress
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 9 October, EU Finance Ministers agreed on the latest revision of the EU list of non-cooperative tax jurisdictions. The update reflects both progress made by jurisdictions through cooperation with the EU and remaining concerns in the areas of tax transparency and fair taxation.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission proposes extending key anti-VAT fraud tools until June 2030
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: A new Commission proposal adopted on 1 October 2026 aims to extend the optional reverse charge mechanism and the quick reaction mechanism against VAT fraud until 30 June 2030.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: eTranslation reaches 1 billion requests in less than a year
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Read more about how eTranslation passed a major milestone: more than 1 billion translation requests in less than a year.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Methane emissions reporting templates – Commission launches call for feedback
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has today published a draft implementing regulation adopting reporting templates for methane emissions in the energy sector and launched a 4-week call for feedback on the document.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Young people meet with Commissioner Hoekstra to discuss EU climate action ahead of COP31
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 1 October 2026, Wopke Hoekstra, Commissioner for Climate, Net-Zero and Clean Growth, met with 16 young people from across Europe for a Youth Policy Dialogue on COP31 to exchange views ahead of the UN climate conference taking place in Antalya, Türkiye from 9 to 20 November.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Ustka’s living maritime heritage: Reviving Baltic fishing traditions for future generations
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Along the windswept Pomeranian coast, Ustka is a town shaped by the sea. For generations, fishing defined daily life here, leaving a legacy that still lives in the harbour, the streets and the memories of local people.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Community-led NEB Lab Housing gathers best practices
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The NEB Lab Housing is working on a comprehensive response to Europe’s housing challenges, bringing together architectural quality, sustainability, resilience and inclusion.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission disburses €1.24 billion to Ukraine for drones and missiles
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission today disbursed €1.24 billion under the defence component part of the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan. The funding covers drones, drone interceptors, drone ammunition and missiles manufactured by Ukrainian entities.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Updated guidance on the €3 customs duty now includes info on Union handling fee
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: From 1 November 2026, the EU will apply a €2 Union handling fee. Guidance on this fee are now included on the previous guidance document on the €3 customs duty. This guidance will be updated periodically as needed.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission fines Kingspan €40 million for providing incorrect and misleading information during merger investigation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has fined Kingspan €40 million for providing incorrect and misleading information during the 2021 Commission review of Kingspan's planned acquisition of Trimo, under the EU Merger Regulation ('EUMR'). Kingspan ultimately abandoned the transaction.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: New EU emissions framework: Simpler rules for pig & poultry farmers, less red tape, and cleaner air
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The measures, which will begin applying between 2030 and 2032, simplify rules for farmers and reduce red tape.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Help shape the future Atlantic Maritime and Macro-regional Strategy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has launched a call for evidence on a future Atlantic Maritime and Macro-regional Strategy to help shape stronger cooperation, resilience, sustainability and territorial cohesion across the Atlantic area. Participate in the call for evidence by 26 November 2026

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioners Síkela and Lahbib visit Dublin to discuss international development and the importance of EU solidarity
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Ireland is a strong partner on humanitarian aid, consistently supporting needs-based, principled EU action, and has a long-standing record of commitment to multilateralism and to the most vulnerable.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Eurobarometer shows consumers' growing trust in EU Ecolabel
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The new survey shows that nearly half of Europeans now recognise its 'flower' logo, up 8% since 2023.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Kos attends inauguration of key railway project on the border between Türkiye and Bulgaria, boosting EU connectivity
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Tomorrow, Commissioner for Enlargement, Marta Kos, will visit Edirne, Türkiye to attend the inauguration of the Çerkezköy–Kapıkule section of the Halkali-Kapikule railway, a key transport link connecting Istanbul and the Bulgarian border.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU gas system prepared for the winter despite lower storage levels
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Gas Coordination Group has met again today to take stock of the current gas market situation in Europe.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Employment Committee follows-up to the 2023 Council Recommendation on strengthening social dialogue in the EU
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 7 and 8 October, the EU Employment Committee (EMCO) held the first review of how EU countries are putting the 2023 Council Recommendation on strengthening social dialogue into practice.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Zaragoza, Benidorm & Estarreja win European Green Cities 2028 awards
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The winners represent Europe's leading cities for urban sustainability.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Results of 07-10-2026 auction (EU-Bills)
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Auction results EU-Bills.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Research and Innovation at the Nucleus: Romania holds Enhanced dialogue with the European Commission
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Romania hosts its Enhanced Dialogue with the European Commission, focusing on research infrastructures, innovation and future EU funding.
